prompt: A 10-second continuous shot. A wooden dining table being set for a family dinner — a hand places a large ceramic dish of roasted chicken and potatoes at the center, still steaming. Another hand sets down plates and a folded napkin. A smartphone rests face down at the edge of the table, forgotten. Warm evening light, a candle already lit, real home dining room, not styled. caption:

Ou a mesa de casa, o prato que ele gosta, e tempo de verdade junto.
